AIRI is designed with privacy first. Local inference stays on your device by default. Cloud requests are sent only after you configure a provider and grant permission. API keys are stored in encrypted local storage. Chat history remains on this device unless you explicitly use a cloud provider.

By using AIRI you accept these terms. AIRI is a local-first AI assistant and is not a medical, legal, or financial advisor. AI responses may be inaccurate; verify important information. You are responsible for your prompts and use of the results. Do not use AIRI for harmful, illegal, deceptive, or safety-critical purposes. Cloud providers process messages under their own privacy policies. Model files remain subject to their third-party licenses. AIRI is provided as-is without a guarantee of uptime or accuracy.
AIRI is built on open-source projects including llama.cpp, Vosk, Silero VAD, Jetpack Compose, Firebase, Coil, and OkHttp.
